{
 "study": "Baker et al. 2023",
 "design": "parallel 2-arm",
 "country": "USA",
 "duration": "6 months",
 "n_randomized_total": "141",
 "experimental_arm": {
  "label": "Low-carbohydrate diet",
  "intervention_description": "Behavioral counseling and key supplemental food. Phase 1 (Go Low) lasted for the first 3 months (target <40 g net carbohydrates per day). During phase 2 (Keep it Low; months 4 through 6), net carbohydrate goal was less than 60 g.",
  "n_randomized": "75",
  "n_analyzed": "73",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.24",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "-0.33 to -0.19",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "CI95: -0.33 to -0.19",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "6.17",
  "hba1c_baseline_sd": "0.31",
  "hba1c_final_mean": "NR",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "NR"
 },
 "control_arm": {
  "label": "Usual diet",
  "intervention_description": "Written information with standard dietary advice; no ongoing recommendations.",
  "n_randomized": "75",
  "n_analyzed": "69",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.04",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "-0.10 to -0.02",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "CI95: -0.10 to -0.02",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "6.14",
  "hba1c_baseline_sd": "0.30",
  "hba1c_final_mean": "NR",

 }
